name: WECO
fix_description: In deposit(), when _weeksLocked == 0, set user.endLockEpoch to currentEpoch (or a minimal value != 0) so that _claimAndLock correctly identifies the lock state. Currently endLockEpoch remains 0, causing hasLocked=false and falling into a flawed reward calculation branch that overpays.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct exploit against a single staking contract using repeated deposit calls, with no flash loans, price manipulation, or complex multi-protocol interactions. An auditor would mainly need to spot broken deposit/accounting logic and reproduce it in a simple loop, which is well within a sub-30-minute exploit-writing task.
